Telescope: https://bit.ly/3IKurJv

EQMOD Cable: https://amzn.to/46L6jPP

Sky-Watcher HEQ5-R Pro Review!

Can a traditional equatorial mount still be a great choice for astrophotography? I’ve been using the HEQ5-R Pro in my backyard with everything from compact refractors to an 8-inch Newtonian, and this review is based on what it’s actually like to set up and image with.

I’ll show you the mount in use, talk about how it handles different telescope rigs, and share what stood out to me. The belt-driven slewing is noticeably quieter than the other Sky-Watcher EQ mounts I’ve used.

I controlled it through an EQMOD cable and ASIAIR for plate solving and imaging, without ever needing to touch the included hand controller.

I also cover the practical buying questions: its 33 lb rated payload, built-in Wi-Fi, lack of an included polar scope, and how it compares with the larger EQ6-R Pro.

If you’re choosing a mount for deep-sky astrophotography (or wondering whether a traditional EQ mount still makes sense alongside today’s strain wave mounts), I hope my experience helps.

#Astrophotography

items.body:
Thank you, SUNLU, for supporting this video. Check out the FilaDC i10 at SUNLU: https://bit.ly/3SiUlsZ & INSLOGIC: https://bit.ly/4qoRUlp

The SUNLU i10 is a $180 filament cabinet that uses a self-regenerating desiccant system to keep up to ten spools at very low humidity without continuously heating them. I spent 6 weeks testing how well it works, tracking moisture loss, power consumption, humidity, and print quality across materials including PLA, PETG, TPU, ASA, PC, and Nylon. In this video, I find out whether the i10 can only keep filament dry, or if it can actually dry out wet spools as well.

GEAR USED:

Telescope: https://bit.ly/4pr6ZSN
Camera: https://bit.ly/3CaQWUI

The Wolf’s Cave Nebula is a delicate blue reflection nebula located at the tip of the dark cloud Barnard 175 in the constellation Cepheus. Ashley and I brought a compact astrophotography setup to our campsite in southern Ontario during the new moon.

In this video, I share the complete experience, from packing and assembling the portable telescope to collecting each exposure beneath the Milky Way. You will also see how stacking many faint images gradually revealed the blue nebula and the enormous cloud of cosmic dust surrounding it.

A quick recipe for the fried preserved Daikon, as promised:

Roughly mince 40g preserved daikon (菜脯). To a hot wok, swirl in 1 tbsp lard, then add the minced daikon together with one clove of minced garlic. Over a medium flame, fry until the daikon begins to get light golden brown bits, ~2-3 minutes. Season with 1 tsp granulated sugar.

items.title: I Automated Pressure Advance Using a Bed-Leveling Sensor
items.summary: 🚀 Turn your obsession with Klipper, custom printers, and machine calibration into a career at Zellerfeld in Hamburg: https://geni.us/ZellerfeldJob Modern 3D printers already contain sensors that could…
items.body:
🚀 Turn your obsession with Klipper, custom printers, and machine calibration into a career at Zellerfeld in Hamburg: https://geni.us/ZellerfeldJob

Modern 3D printers already contain sensors that could do far more than simply level the bed. In this video, I use the load cell inside a Prusa Nextruder to automatically estimate Pressure Advance, test maximum flow rate, and explore the potential for detecting clogs, crashes, and extrusion problems. The result is an open-source proof of concept showing how smarter software could unlock entirely new capabilities from hardware that is already inside our printers.
